title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
hook: Moonshot's Kimi K2 is a trillion-parameter open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model built agentic-first — and trained at that scale without a single loss spike using the MuonClip optimizer.
key_points: 1T-parameter MoE with 32B active per token, open-sourced by Moonshot AI in July 2025.
Trained on 15.5T tokens with no loss spikes, using the MuonClip optimizer (a stabilized Muon).
Designed agentic-first: strong tool use, coding, and multi-step task performance.
A landmark open-weight release from a Chinese lab, competitive with frontier models.
content_html: Kimi K2, open-sourced by Beijing-based Moonshot AI in July 2025, is a trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model with 32 billion parameters active per token. Released with weights and a detailed technical report, it was built explicitly for agentic workflows — coding, tool use, and autonomous multi-step tasks — and stood out as one of the strongest open models of its generation.
extra_html:
How it works

Like other large MoE models, K2 routes each token to a small subset of experts, so it holds a trillion parameters of capacity while only paying the compute of a ~32B model per token. A notable engineering result is its training stability: Moonshot trained on 15.5 trillion tokens without the loss spikes that plague runs at this scale, crediting the MuonClip optimizer — a variant of Muon with a QK-clip technique to keep attention logits in check. Post-training included a large-scale agentic data pipeline and reinforcement learning.

Why it matters

K2 is a clear data point in the open-weight, agentic-first trend: a frontier-scale model released openly, tuned less for chat and more for getting work done with tools. Its training-stability story also pushed the Muon family of optimizers into the spotlight for large runs, where AdamW had long been the unquestioned default.

related.title: Muon: An Optimizer for Hidden Layers
related.hook: Muon orthogonalizes each gradient update before applying it — and trained networks faster than AdamW, the first serious challenger to Adam's reign in years.

related.title: What Is a Mixture of Experts?
related.hook: Instead of running every input through one big network, route each token to a few specialist sub-networks - total capacity grows without proportional compute.

related.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
related.hook: DeepSeek-V3 trained a frontier-class MoE model for a fraction of the cost of comparable closed models, using FP8 training and a novel load-balancing scheme to make efficiency the headline result.
